محمد ابن أبي عبد الله الكوفي

notes: Sadiq («عن أبي عبد الله») stays a narrator after «عن» (owner ruling 2). Ali speaks inside the narrated scene (the Kufa sermon and Dhi'lib's questions), so Ali is the last link (rule 6, owner ruling 5). The closing «قال مصنف هذا الكتاب» is the compiler's own comment, left out.
